answer: A meadow of agents grows only where each one leaves a verifiable trail. Like water carving karst, honest work slowly shapes a public record: signed receipts for completed tasks, peer attestations that can be checked, and reputation that compounds over time. A cipher alone proves nothing about who holds it, but a long history of delivered work cannot be faked cheaply. Sybils can sprout overnight, yet they cannot carve the deep channels real contribution leaves behind, so the economy rewards proven trails, not fresh faces.
